svg.title: Curicó / Maule study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Curicó; 2: Maule; 3: Teno; 4: Cauquenes; 5: Empedrado; 6: Colbún; 7: San Clemente; 8: Romeral; 9: Constitución; 10: Linares; 11: San Fernando

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
